description: DEF CON 33 Hardware Hacking Village talks covering embedded firmware exploits, physical peripheral attacks, and microcontroller hardware hacking.

talks.title: All your keyboards are belong to us!
talks.teaser: Live tutorial on attacking keyboards to intercept plaintext and hijack sessions prior to OS encryption.

talks.title: The PowerPoint Glove
talks.teaser: Repurposing a vintage Nintendo Power Glove into a Bluetooth HID presentation clicker using an ESP32 micro-controller and custom firmware.

talks.title: The Missing Link: Draytek’s New RCEs Complete the Chain
talks.teaser: Unveils novel remote code execution vulnerabilities in Draytek enterprise routers to achieve pre-auth exploit chains and persistent backdoors.
